With Diwali and Chhath Puja approaching, Indian Railways has announced an extensive plan to manage the festive rush. Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw details preparations, including 18,000 special trains, holding areas at around 20 stations, additional ticket counters and 700 AI-enabled cameras. Here's what the Railways is doing to manage the crowds and ensure safer journeys.
